the majority of pulmonary large cell neuroendo- crine carcinomas (LCNECs) are genetically similar to small cell lung carcinomas (SCLCs), and that a minority are similar to classic large cell carcinomas (CLCCs).
LCNEC has a similar pattern of genetic alteration to SCLC and a different pattern to CLCC.
